Comment: The EFS file system policy this sample applies. setup.sh renders <EFS_FILE_SYSTEM_ARN>, <EFS_ACCESS_POINT_ARN> and <EFS_CSI_NODE_ROLE_ARN> from the live cluster before applying it with `aws efs put-file-system-policy`. It requires TLS, confines every allow to this access point reached through a mount target, grants only ClientMount and ClientWrite (never ClientRootAccess), and allows only the EFS CSI driver's node principal. An IAM-signed mount by any other principal falls through to no allow and is refused.
